caption:
🏙️ City-dwellers, country by country — 1960 → 2024.

In 1960, 132 million Chinese lived in cities. Today 928 million do — more than India and the United States combined. Until 1978 China kept its people on the land; once the economy opened, hundreds of millions moved to the factories. Watch the world tip majority-urban in 2007 🌆

📊 Data: Gapminder, Systema Globalis (CC BY 4.0). No world total is published for this series.
